name: home-new-tab
description: Firefox new tab: clock, bookmarks, weather, CBR rates, DTF, Steam wishlist deals

scripts.dev: web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md scripts updates.json
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md scripts updates.json
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md scripts updates.json --overwrite-dest
